links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy and completeness of ChatGPT dental answers, including diagnostic methods and post-operative instructions
links.effect: Preventive dentistry scored 4.3/5; oral surgery 3.9/5 and oral cancer 3.6/5, with gaps in post-operative instructions, personalized risk assessments, and specialized diagnostic methods.
links.quote: While achieving the highest score for preventive dentistry at 4.3/5 and being able to communicate the complex information coherently, the tool showed lower accuracy for oral surgery and oral cancer, scoring 3.9/5 and 3.6/5, respectively, with several gaps for post-operative instructions, personalized risk assessments, and specialized diagnostic methods.

screen.reason: The study evaluates ChatGPT's response accuracy, completeness, and safety risks on a benchmark set of 50 dental questions scored by expert rubrics, without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
